job: Kelantan zon 1 (KTN01) recipe from the banked JAKIM annual and the +1 min flag
source: sea2/captures/msia-ktn01-tahunan-2026.html (waktusolatmalaysia.org mirror of JAKIM zon KTN01, 2026 annual)

transcription_status.result: BLOCKED: no verbatim Kelantan table could be transcribed
transcription_status.searched: sea2/captures (18 files, no image of any kind), thmsg/captures (Malaysia pass), and a filename scan of the whole o1k-wide tree for kelantan/zon1/zon2/jabatan
transcription_status.found: only text notes recording that the Jabatan Mufti posts monthly zon1/zon2 images on facebook.com/MUFTIKELANTAN; the poster images themselves were never banked
transcription_status.consequence: zon 1 and zon 2 rows of the mufti table remain unread; the recipe question is answered only for the JAKIM comparator

ktn01_recipe.statement: at 6.1200 N / 102.2400 E the printed KTN01 columns sit at a fixed convention on all 365 days: subuh at sun depth 17.64 deg (17.49-17.80), isyak at 17.36 deg (17.18-17.51), zohor at true noon +2.6 min, asar at Shafi +2 min, maghrib at sunset +2 min, imsak = subuh - 10 min exactly
ktn01_recipe.angles_read: the twilight pair is 18/18 minus 2-3 minutes, or 17.6/17.4 with no margin; angle and margin are not separable at one-minute print resolution
ktn01_recipe.refuted: isha 17 (the KTN02 exception value) is outside the measurement by about 1 deg, i.e. 4 minutes

flag_plus_one_minute.comparator: KTN01 2026-03-18 imsak 05:59, subuh 06:09, syuruk 07:17, zohor 13:22, asar 16:32, maghrib 19:24, isyak 20:29 (this file, row 2026-03-18)
flag_plus_one_minute.finding: the +1 falls on subuh and syuruk together; a twilight angle cannot move syuruk, so the delta is a column or clock convention, not a recipe difference
flag_plus_one_minute.unresolved: one sample from a third-hand mirror cannot separate a one-minute whole-table offset (0.25 deg of longitude) from a morning-pair convention; the mufti table itself would settle it

verdict.zon1_zon2_against_jakim: unanswerable without the mufti tables: not evidence either way
verdict.plus_one_flag: resolved as a non-angular one-minute convention, not a different recipe
